1040.description: A single leg squat on a machine that supports balance while you load one leg through full depth.
instructions: Step into the machine and put one foot on the platform with the other leg lifted or extended.
Brace your core and release the safety.
Lower slowly into a deep squat on one leg.
Press through your heel to stand.
Keep your knee in line with your toes. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

1104.description: A triceps extension leaning on straps. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Hold the handles and lean forward.
Keep your elbows bent and by your head.
Straighten your arms.
Keep your body straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your elbows still.

1168.description: A face-down stretch that lengthens the abdominals, similar to a cobra position.
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Press up slowly, straightening your arms as far as is comfortable.
Keep your hips on the floor and relax your glutes.
Look forward and feel the stretch along your belly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower down.

1232.description: A squat on a seated lever machine with a supported torso. It loads the thighs and glutes with a guided path.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder width apart.
Push through your feet to extend your legs.
Lower slowly until your knees are comfortably bent.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.

1296.description: A pike push-up with your feet on a stability ball. It builds shoulders and chest and works your core to hold the ball steady.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands on the floor and your shins resting on the stability ball.
Engage your core and lift your hips up towards the ceiling, rolling the ball towards your hands.
Keep your legs straight and your body in a pike position, forming an inverted V shape.
Bend your elbows and lower your upper body towards the floor, keeping your head in line with your hands.
Push through your hands and extend your arms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手放在地板上，小腿放在稳定球上。
收紧核心肌群，将臀部抬向天花板，将球滚向双手。
保持双腿伸直，身体呈屈体姿势，形成倒V字形。
弯曲肘部，将上半身降低到地板上，保持头部与双手在一条直线上。
用手推动并伸展双臂以返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1360.description: A one-arm row using a smith machine bar. It trains the upper back and lats one side at a time along a guided path.
instructions: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to waist level.
Stand facing the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Grasp the bar with one hand using an overhand grip, with your palm facing down.
Keep your elbow close to your body and pull the bar towards your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机杆的高度调整至腰部水平。
面对史密斯机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
用一只手正手握住杠铃，手掌朝下。
保持肘部靠近身体，将杠铃拉向腰部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

1424.description: Sit on the floor and cross one ankle over the opposite knee, then lean in. It stretches the glutes and the outer hip.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your right knee and cross your right ankle over your left thigh.
Place your right hand on the ground behind you for support.
With your left hand, gently press down on your right knee to deepen the stretch.
Hold the stretch for 30 seconds to 1 minute.
Switch sides and repeat.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
弯曲右膝，将右脚踝交叉在左大腿上。
将右手放在身后的地面上以获得支撑。
用左手轻轻按下右膝盖以加深伸展。
保持拉伸 30 秒到 1 分钟。
换边并重复。

1488.description: A simple stretch that opens the front of the shoulders and chest by clasping the hands behind you.
instructions: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lift your hands gently away from your body until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest open and avoid arching your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly.

1552.description: An explosive squat jump holding light dumbbells at your sides. It builds power in the legs and gets the heart pumping.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Explode upward and jump as high as you can.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and sink straight into the next squat.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking your toes.

1616.description: A preacher curl on a lever machine with an overhand grip. It shifts work to the forearms and brachialis.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine.
Grasp the handles with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Rest your upper arms on the preacher pad, ensuring your elbows are fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the handles towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the handles back to the starting position, fully extending your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在杠杆机上。
反手握住手柄，手掌朝上。
将上臂放在牧师垫上，确保肘部完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将手柄卷向肩膀。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将手柄放回起始位置，充分伸展肘部。
重复所需的重复次数。

1680.description: A standing one-arm curl with your chest over an incline bench. It isolates the biceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Place your other hand on an incline bench for support.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder by contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住哑铃。
将另一只手放在倾斜的长凳上以获得支撑。
保持上臂静止，通过收缩二头肌将哑铃向肩膀弯曲。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1744.description: A bodyweight dip using a stability ball as the support. The unstable surface makes your triceps and shoulders work harder to stay steady.
instructions: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Place your hands on the ball beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Engage your triceps and push through your hands to lift your body off the ball, straightening your arms.
Lower your body back down by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
将双手放在臀部旁边的球上，手指指向前方。
启动你的三头肌并用力推动你的身体，将你的身体抬离球，伸直你的手臂。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低，使其靠近身体两侧。
重复所需的重复次数。

1808.description: Lying on your back and pulling your knees in stretches your lower back and hips. A soothing option after long periods of sitting.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Draw both knees toward your chest and hold them with your hands.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1872.description: Plate-loaded preacher curl that isolates the biceps with the arms supported.
instructions: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grip the handles with your palms up.
Curl up until your biceps are fully contracted.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

1936.description: Lying on your back and guiding a crossed knee down across the body to stretch the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Use your hand to guide the crossed knee gently down and across your body.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2192.description: A steady, low-impact walk on the elliptical that builds endurance and works the legs without pounding the joints.
instructions: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles.
Start walking forward in a smooth rhythm.
Stand tall and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Set a resistance and pace you can keep up while breathing steadily.
Continue for 15-45 minutes.
Slow down for a minute before you step off.

2768.description: Bringing the leg inward across the body, working the inner thigh.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other leg slightly out to the side.
Bring it back in and across the front of the standing leg, then pause.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2960.description: A stationary lunge with dumbbells at your sides. It strengthens one leg at a time, mainly the quads and glutes.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and take a long stance, one foot forward.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

3088.description: Explosive hops from a deep squat, like a frog. They build leg power and get your heart pumping.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and sink into a deep squat.
Place your fingertips on the floor between your feet.
Jump forward and up, swinging your arms.
Land softly back in the squat.
Reset and hop again right away.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

3216.description: A push-up where one hand taps the chest at the bottom of each rep, alternating sides. It adds a stability challenge to the chest and triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
As you lower yourself, tap your chest with your right hand.
Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time tapping your chest with your left hand.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
当你降低身体时，用右手拍打胸部。
将自己推回到起始位置。
重复这个动作，这次用左手敲击胸部。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3280.description: A crunch with a rotation, with the legs on a bench, to train the abs and the obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up and rotate so one shoulder moves toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides on each rep.

3344.description: A machine crossover that brings your arms together across the body, isolating the chest.
instructions: Set the seat height and grip the handles with a slight elbow bend.
Sit tall with your back against the pad.
Sweep your arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the center.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.

3408.description: A standing rotation of the upper body that mobilises the thoracic spine and warms up the waist.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands clasped in front of your chest.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your upper body to one side as far as is comfortable.
Return through the centre and rotate the other way.
Keep it smooth for 10-15 reps per side.

3472.description: A lying hip stretch pulling the knee in toward the chest.
instructions: Lie on your back.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Keep your other leg relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
Switch legs.

3536.description: A harder inverted row with the feet elevated on a third chair. It builds the back and arms.
instructions: Set a bar across two stable chairs and place a third chair at your feet.
Lie under the bar and grip it overhand.
Put your heels on the third chair.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.

3664.description: A dumbbell side plank with a reverse fly. It trains the rear delts, upper back and obliques.
instructions: Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your forearm on the ground directly below your shoulder, keeping your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand, with your arm extended straight down towards the ground.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
While maintaining the side plank position, lift the dumbbell up towards the ceiling, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 首先侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
将前臂放在肩膀正下方的地面上，保持肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
用你的上手握住哑铃，手臂垂直向下伸向地面。
收紧核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头部到脚后跟形成一条直线。
在保持侧平板支撑位置的同时，将哑铃向天花板方向举起，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

3728.description: A step up with a barbell racked on your front shoulders, which keeps your torso upright and works the quads.
instructions: Rack a barbell across your front shoulders and stand facing a box.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel to step up and stand tall.
Lower back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3792.description: Lying on your back, you pedal your arms against the band like a bicycle. It hits your abs with added resistance.
instructions: Lie on your back with the band anchored behind your head, a handle in each hand.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Alternate pulling one handle toward your opposite knee in a pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue at a steady pace for your set.

3856.description: A smith machine squat with resistance band tension added. It builds your quads and glutes under a guided bar path.
instructions: Set the bar on the smith machine and attach the band as required.
Place the bar on your upper back with your feet slightly forward.
Lower into a squat until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up.

3920.description: A triceps pushdown performed while sitting or lying on the floor with the cable set low.
instructions: Set a cable at a low or mid position and sit on the floor facing it.
Hold the handle with elbows tucked at your sides.
Press the handle down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your upper arms still.

3984.description: A push up followed by a pike with a reach to the toes. It trains the chest, shoulders and core.
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Do a push up.
Lift your hips into a pike.
Reach one hand to the opposite toe.
Return to plank and alternate.

4048.description: Split squat with the dumbbell held on the same side as the working front leg. It tests balance and leg strength.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and step into a split stance, the dumbbell on the same side as your front leg.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front foot to rise.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

4112.description: Seated battle rope waves that raise your heart rate while working the arms and core.
instructions: Sit tall on the floor or a bench holding the ends of the ropes.
Brace your core.
Whip the ropes up and down in alternating waves.
Keep a steady fast rhythm for 20-30 seconds.
Rest, then repeat.

4176.description: A shrug performed supported on parallel bars. It lifts and lowers the shoulders to train the traps.
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms.
Let your shoulders sink down.
Push up to elevate your shoulders toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Keep your elbows locked.

4240.description: A standing Pallof press with a resistance band anchored at chest height. It trains your core to resist rotation.
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Step away until the band is taut and brace your core.
Press your hands straight out in front of you.
Hold for a second without twisting, then bring them back.
Complete your reps and switch sides.

4368.description: A bent-over row with a cable rope, allowing a neutral grip and a good squeeze at the end.
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hinge forward with a flat back.
Grip the rope with palms facing each other.
Pull the rope toward your lower chest.
Spread the rope as you squeeze your back.
Lower with control.

4432.description: A lying neck twist with light resistance to work the muscles that rotate the head.
instructions: Lie face up with a light weight resting on your forehead.
Keep your chin slightly tucked.
Rotate your head slowly to one side.
Return to the middle and rotate to the other side.
Keep the movement small and controlled.

4496.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the top of the forearm (extensors). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your top of the forearm (extensors) on a table with your palm facing down.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4560.description: A kneeling lean-back that stretches and strengthens the front of the thighs and the core.
instructions: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart and your body upright.
Cross your arms or put your hands on your hips.
Squeeze your glutes and lean back from the knees as one straight line.
Go back as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up to the start.
Keep your hips forward.

4624.description: A weighted crunch holding a dumbbell at the chest to add resistance for the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a dumbbell held against your chest.
Brace your abs.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower back down slowly.

4688.description: A pushdown against a band anchored overhead that isolates the triceps.
instructions: Anchor the band high and hold the handles with elbows bent at your sides.
Keep your elbows pinned.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Return slowly to the start.

4752.description: A side squat where you sit back toward a bench while holding a dumbbell. It works the thighs and glutes one side at a time.
instructions: Stand sideways to a bench holding a dumbbell at your chest, feet wide.
Shift your weight to the leg nearest the bench.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep the other leg straight.
Drive up through your heel and repeat, then switch sides.

4816.description: A goblet squat with a two-second pause in the bottom. The pause builds leg strength and control out of the hole.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly out.
Squat down with your chest tall until your thighs are at least parallel.
Hold the bottom position for two seconds.
Drive through your heels to stand.

4880.description: Lying on your back, you cross your legs back and forth. It works the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs raised slightly off the floor.
Press your lower back down.
Cross one leg over the other.
Switch and cross the other way.
Continue smoothly.

4944.description: A standing hip mobility move where you draw a figure eight with the bent knee. It loosens the hips.
instructions: Stand tall and hold a support if needed.
Lift one knee in front of you.
Trace a slow figure eight with your knee.
Keep your standing leg steady.
Keep your torso upright.
Switch legs.

5008.description: A chin-up on suspension straps. It builds the lats and arms with a natural hand path.
instructions: Hold the handles palms facing you and lean back.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Pull your chest toward the handles.
Squeeze your elbows close to your sides.
Lower under control.
Adjust your foot position to change difficulty.

5072.description: Sit up from the floor with a kettlebell and press it overhead at the top. A core and shoulder combo move.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Curl and sit up using your abs.
Press the kettlebell overhead as you reach the top.
Lower it back to your chest.
Roll back down slowly and repeat.

5328.description: An overhead press done standing. It builds shoulder strength and total-body stability.
instructions: Hold the bar at shoulder height with hands just outside shoulder-width.
Stand tall with glutes and core braced.
Press the bar straight overhead, moving your head back slightly.
Lock out with the bar over mid-foot.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders.
Avoid leaning back.

5392.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the hamstrings and glutes. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Sit with the roller under your thighs and hands behind you.
Place the roller under the hamstrings and glutes and let your body weight settle onto it.
Lift your hips and roll from the knee toward the glutes.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5904.description: A gentle twist from hands and knees. Loosens the upper back and shoulders.
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Slide one arm under your chest and rest your shoulder on the floor.
Keep your hips over your knees.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Return and switch arms.

5968.description: A burpee with a trunk rotation on the jump, raising your heart rate while challenging the whole body.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Perform a push-up if you like.
Jump your feet forward under your hips.
Explode up, rotating your trunk as you jump, and land softly.
Alternate twist directions each rep.

6032.description: A seated cable row with a V handle and a neutral grip. It builds the mid back and lats.
instructions: Sit at the low pulley, feet on the platform, knees slightly bent, and hold the V bar.
Sit tall with your chest up and arms straight.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly, keeping your torso still.
Extend your arms slowly until you feel a stretch in your back.

6160.description: A hip thrust with the soles of your feet together and knees out, holding a dumbbell on your hips. It focuses on the glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees out.
Rest a dumbbell on your hips.
Drive your hips up by pressing through your feet.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your ribs down.

6288.description: A yoga inverted V on your forearms. It stretches the shoulders and hamstrings and builds shoulder strength.
instructions: Start on hands and knees, then lower to your forearms.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up high.
Press your forearms into the floor.
Let your head hang between your arms.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

6544.description: A squat holding a low cable at your chest. The front load helps you stay upright and drives the thighs and glutes.
instructions: Attach a handle or rope to a low pulley and hold it against your chest.
Step back until there is tension and set your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest tall.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your feet to stand up.
Keep your elbows pointing down throughout.

6800.description: A seated combo that pairs an overhead press with a Russian twist, feet off the floor. It challenges the trunk and shoulders together.
instructions: Sit leaning back slightly with knees bent and feet off the floor.
Hold dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press both dumbbells overhead.
Lower them, then twist your torso to one side.
Twist to the other side and repeat the sequence.

7056.description: A standing reverse curl that ends with a forearm rotation. It targets the forearms and brachialis.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with an overhand grip at your thighs.
Curl the weights up while keeping your elbows tucked.
At the top, rotate your forearms so the palms turn up.
Rotate back and lower slowly.
Keep your wrists strong and avoid swinging.

9040.description: Leaning into a wall, you drive your knees in a fast running pattern. It practises sprint posture and builds speed.
instructions: Place your hands on a wall and lean forward with a straight body line.
Brace your core.
Drive one knee up while the other leg stays extended.
Switch legs quickly in a running rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Go hard for 10-20 seconds, then rest.

9488.description: A folded stance with hips high and head down, shifting weight over your hands. It opens the hamstrings and loads the shoulders.
instructions: Start on all fours and walk your feet in while lifting your hips high.
Form an upside-down V with straight arms and legs.
Press the floor away and let your head hang between your arms.
Keep your heels reaching toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

9872.description: A lying lateral raise where each hand grips the opposite cable handle and the arms sweep up and across. It hits the side delts with constant tension.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench between two low cable pulleys and grab each handle with the opposite hand.
Start with your arms crossed over your body and a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise both arms out and up in a wide arc until your hands are about shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to the crossed position.
Keep your back flat on the bench and avoid swinging.

10192.description: A kettlebell swing that travels to the side, adding rotation work for the obliques to the hip snap.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulders and a kettlebell in both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and swing the bell up toward chest height, angled to one side.
Let it swing back down with a flat back.
Finish the reps on one side, then switch.

10384.description: A squat holding a sandbag against the chest, training the legs and the core.
instructions: Hold a sandbag in a bear hug against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit back and down into a squat with your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand up.
Keep the bag tight to your body.

11088.description: A reverse lunge with an overhead reach and a twist. It warms up the legs, hips and spine together.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms by your sides.
Step one leg back into a lunge and reach both arms overhead.
Twist your torso toward the front leg.
Untwist, then push through your front foot to stand.
Alternate legs for the set.

11792.description: A static curl hold that builds biceps endurance.
instructions: Kneel upright with your elbows bent at about 90 degrees.
Hold your hands in front of you with palms up.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Squeeze your biceps and hold the position.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

0016.description: Lying face down, you curl your legs toward your glutes against assistance. Trains the hamstrings.
instructions: Lie face down on a mat or bench with your legs fully extended.
Have a partner or use a resistance band to secure your ankles.
Engage your hamstrings and lift your legs towards your glutes, keeping your knees straight.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 脸朝下躺在垫子或长凳上，双腿完全伸展。
找一个伙伴或使用阻力带来固定脚踝。
收紧腿筋，将双腿抬向臀肌，保持膝盖伸直。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0080.description: A curl with an overhand grip. Trains the biceps, brachialis and forearms.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keep your upper arms stationary and exhale as you curl the barbell upward, contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the barbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the barbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale as you slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，正手握住杠铃，手掌朝下。
保持上臂静止，向上弯举杠铃时呼气，收缩二头肌。
继续举起杠铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且杠铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置，保持上臂静止。
重复所需的重复次数。

0208.description: A seated row from a high pulley with an underhand grip. Pull to the torso and squeeze the back, keeping the back straight.
instructions: Sit on the seat facing the cable machine with your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the cable attachment with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly forward from your hips.
Pull the cable towards your torso by retracting your shoulder blades and squeezing your back muscles.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the contraction, then slowly release the cable back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在面向电缆机的座位上，双脚平放在地板上。
用手握住电缆附件，手掌朝上，双手与肩同宽。
保持背部挺直，并从臀部稍微向前倾斜。
通过缩回肩胛骨并挤压背部肌肉，将电缆拉向躯干。
在收缩的峰值处暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将电缆释放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0272.description: A stability ball crunch with the arms held straight. The extended arms make it harder for the abs.
instructions: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Lie back on the ball until your lower back is supported and your upper body is parallel to the floor.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body off the ball, curling your shoulders towards your hips.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
仰卧在球上，直到下背部得到支撑并且上半身与地板平行。
将双手放在脑后或交叉放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离球，将肩膀向臀部弯曲。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0336.description: A dumbbell lunge stepping forward with each leg in turn. It trains the glutes, quads and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Keep your back straight and your chest up as you lower your body.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg.
Alternate legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
降低身体时保持背部挺直、挺胸。
推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
左腿重复上述动作。
交替腿进行所需的重复次数。

0400.description: Seated with a dumbbell on one knee, you lift your heel and lower it slowly. It works the calf, especially the deeper soleus.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell resting on your right thigh.
Extend your left leg straight out in front of you, keeping your foot flexed.
Place the ball of your right foot on an elevated surface, such as a step or weight plate.
Using your calf muscles, raise your right heel as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地面上，将哑铃放在右大腿上。
将左腿伸直到身前，保持脚部弯曲。
将右脚掌放在升高的表面上，例如台阶或配重板。
使用小腿肌肉，尽可能高地抬高右脚跟。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

0464.description: A front plank with a trunk twist. It works the abs, obliques and shoulders while you stay stable.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Engage your core and glutes to maintain a stable position.
Rotate your torso to the right, lifting your right arm and extending it towards the ceiling.
Keep your hips and legs stable as you twist.
Hold for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the twist on the left side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体从头到脚成一条直线。
调动你的核心和臀部以保持稳定的位置。
将躯干向右旋转，抬起右臂并向天花板延伸。
扭转时保持臀部和腿部稳定。
保持片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在左侧重复扭转。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0528.description: With two kettlebells, you dip your knees and drive the bells overhead. It builds the shoulders and legs.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Initiate the movement by explosively extending your hips, knees, and ankles, driving the kettlebells overhead.
As the kettlebells reach the top, press them fully overhead, locking out your arms.
Lower the kettlebells back to the starting position by bending your elbows and bringing them back down to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽，每只手握住一个壶铃，与肩同高。
稍微弯曲膝盖并启动核心。
通过爆发性伸展臀部、膝盖和脚踝来开始运动，将壶铃举过头顶。
当壶铃到达顶部时，将它们完全压过头顶，锁定手臂。
弯曲肘部并将壶铃放回至肩膀高度，将壶铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0592.description: With your arms on a preacher pad, you curl the handles up. Isolates the biceps with no swinging.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine.
Place your upper arms on the pad and grip the handles with an underhand grip.
Keep your back straight and your elbows positioned on the pad.
Exhale and curl your forearms towards your upper arms, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在杠杆机上。
将上臂放在垫子上，并用反手握住手柄。
保持背部挺直，并将肘部放在垫子上。
呼气并将前臂向上臂弯曲，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0656.description: A push-up with your hands on a stability ball. The unstable surface adds core and shoulder stability work to the chest effort.
instructions: Place the stability ball on the ground and position yourself facing down with your hands on the ball, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs straight out behind you, balancing on your toes.
Engage your core and lower your chest towards the ball by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将稳定球放在地上，面朝下，双手放在球上，与肩同宽。
将双腿伸直在身后，用脚趾保持平衡。
弯曲肘部，调动核心力量，将胸部向球方向降低，保持身体呈一条直线。
在底部暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0720.description: You pull yourself up to one side of the bar, then slide across to the other. Builds the lats, arms and grip.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body relaxed.
Pull yourself up by bending your elbows and bringing your chin towards the bar, while keeping your body straight.
Once your chin is above the bar, lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住引体向上杆，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体放松。
弯曲肘部并将下巴朝向杠铃杆，将自己拉起，同时保持身体挺直。
一旦你的下巴高于杠铃，就将自己放低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0784.description: A squat with a loop band around the legs or under the feet to add resistance. It builds the quads and glutes and keeps the knees pushing out.
instructions: Place the band as set up for the drill and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
Push your knees out against the band.
Stand up by driving through your heels.

0848.description: A seated neck extension with a weighted head harness, working the muscles at the back of the neck.
instructions: Sit on a bench wearing a head harness with a light weight hanging in front.
Lean slightly forward and rest your hands on your thighs.
Let your chin drop toward your chest in a controlled way.
Raise your head back up until your neck is neutral.
Repeat slowly for the set.
Keep your back straight and use a light load.

0912.description: A lying leg raise against a band. It works the hip muscles.
instructions: Lie on your back with the band around your legs.
Keep your legs straight.
Raise one leg against the band.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides.

0976.description: A seated concentration curl with a band, with the elbow braced on the thigh. It isolates the biceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your legs spread apart and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold one end of the band in your hand and step on the other end with your foot on the same side.
Lean forward slightly and rest your elbow on the inside of your thigh, just above the knee.
With your palm facing up, slowly curl your hand towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hand back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双腿分开，双脚平放在地上。
用手握住带子的一端，用脚踩在另一端上，同时将脚放在同一侧。
稍微向前倾，将肘部放在大腿内侧，膝盖上方。
手掌朝上，慢慢地将手向肩膀弯曲，保持上臂静止。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
